english.title: Conspire to require another person to perform forced / compulsory labour
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) conspired together with

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSONS..)]_
(C)_[another person]_
(D)_[other persons]_

to require another person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE OTHER PERSON..), to perform forced or compulsory labour in circumstances, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CIRCUMSTANCES..), when you knew or ought to have known that

(E)_[he]_
(F)_[she]_

was being required to perform such labour
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Criminal Law Act 1977.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: References to requiring a person to perform forced or compulsory labour are to be construed in accordance with Article 4 of the Human Rights Convention (which prohibits a person being required to perform forced or compulsory labour).

(B)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSONS..)]_
(C)_[rhywun arall]_
(D)_[phobl eraill]_
